plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Pre-Health Occupations A.S. Degree - Allied Health Local GE' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published September 30, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7817/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: CRC Local. Map states Total Units 57.5-64; lower bound 57.5 encoded = 14+16+12.5+15 (semester sums verified at lower bound: Sem 1 Area L2 3-5 -> 3; Sem 2 BIOL 102/302 -> 3; Sem 3 AH 498 0.5-4 -> 0.5). AH 108 formerly AH 110. BIOL choice: BIOL 102 Essentials of Human Anatomy and Physiology (4 units) or BIOL 302 Concepts of Human Anatomy and Physiology (3 units; advisory ENGL C1000) — lower bound 3 encoded. Map footnote: alternatively BIOL 430 A&P (5 u) and BIOL 431 A&P (5 u), recommended in Semesters 3 and 4 respectively; the map's 'Selecting the Right BIOL Course' note directs students to consult a counselor to determine the right Anatomy & Physiology course for their career. AH 120 co- or pre-requisite per map: AH 311 and (BIOL 102 or BIOL 302); both precede Semester 3, encoded as prereq with one_of. BIOL 302 is carried under external_prereqs because it appears only as an option of the Semester 2 BIOL choice slot (validator resolves slot codes, not options). AH 498 Work Experience in Allied Health (0.5-4 units, lower bound 0.5): student must be in a paid or unpaid internship, volunteer position or job. Elective suggestions: PSYC C1000 Intro to Psych (Sem 3). Elective units are determined by the number needed to total 60 units for graduation; refer to Course Number for the appropriate course level. Advisories (recommended, not required, per map legend): BIOL 302 advisory ENGL C1000; COMM C1000/COMM 331 advisory eligible for ENGWR 300; COMM C1004 advisory eligible for ENGL C1000; PHYS 310 advisory Elementary Algebra or HS Equivalent; ANTH 313 advisory eligible for ENGL C1000. Completion of this degree does not guarantee enrollment/admission in any health occupation program.
